name: Asian Alliance International Public Company Limited
summary: Asian Alliance International Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells pet food and ready-to-eat human food products in Thailand, the United States, the United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Italy, Germany, and internationally. The company offers wet pet food products, such as soups, salads, fish and meat dishes, mousse, and pate, as well as dry pet food products for dogs and cats under the monchou, monchou balanced, Hajiko, and PRO brand names; and ready-to-eat human food products made of tuna, salmon, tilapia, sea bass, mackerel, and shrimp in sealed containers.
